answer.label: In short
answer.lead: White-label WordPress development means MMC builds WordPress sites for your agency's clients while you present the work as yours. We produce custom themes, WooCommerce stores, plugins, migrations and speed fixes from your designs, with the client able to edit pages themselves after handover.

stages.breaks: Solving every feature with another plugin.
stages.why: Each plugin is another update, another conflict and another way for the site to break.
stages.does: We build what we can in the theme, keep a short vetted plugin list and remove what is unused.

stages.k: Build a theme that updates safely
stages.breaks: Customising someone else's theme in place.
stages.why: The next theme update erases the changes, and your client blames you.
stages.does: We build a custom theme or a child theme, so the site can be updated without losing work.

stages.k: Plan the move with a way back
stages.breaks: Moving a live site with no rollback.
stages.why: Lost forms, broken links and missing redirects show up after your client has noticed them.
stages.does: Backups, a staging copy, a redirect map and a way back before anything goes live.

stages.breaks: Blaming the host for every slow page.
stages.why: Heavy images, scripts and plugins are usually the cause, and a new host does not fix them.
stages.does: We trim images, scripts and plugins, set up caching and test on a phone before handover.

stages.breaks: Handing over a site only a developer can change.
stages.why: Every text edit becomes a ticket to you, which erodes the care plan you sell.
stages.does: Editable blocks and a short guide, in your branding, so routine edits stay with your client.
